subject: Boise lease Suite 170: LL redline 1, early-termination economics

items.label: Total base rent over the term, unchanged from as-received
items.source: LL-Redline-1-Suite170.docx (landlord redline 16 Nov 2026; copy at projects/legal/boise-lease-suite170/03-LL-Redline-1-Suite170.docx) s.1 and s.3. Sum of every monthly rent payment from Rent Commencement to lease end. Lease years run from 1 Mar 2027 (Year 1 = Mar 2027-Feb 2028). Term ends 38 months after 1 Jan 2027 possession.

items.label: Remaining rent owed from 1 Jan 2029 to lease end with no exit right
items.source: LL-Redline-1-Suite170.docx (landlord redline 16 Nov 2026; copy at projects/legal/boise-lease-suite170/03-LL-Redline-1-Suite170.docx) s.1 and s.3. Sum of monthly rent for every month from January 2029 through the last month of the term (Feb 2030), using the Year 2/Year 3 rate in force each month (lease years from 1 Mar).

items.label: Rent paid during a 3-month notice period Jan-Mar 2029
items.source: LL-Redline-1-Suite170.docx (landlord redline 16 Nov 2026; copy at projects/legal/boise-lease-suite170/03-LL-Redline-1-Suite170.docx) s.3. Monthly rent for January, February and March 2029 (lease years from 1 Mar 2027).

items.label: Unamortized free rent at a 31 Mar 2029 termination
items.source: LL-Redline-1-Suite170.docx (landlord redline 16 Nov 2026; copy at projects/legal/boise-lease-suite170/03-LL-Redline-1-Suite170.docx) s.1 and struck s.20 (Fin draft clause). Value of the two abated months (2 x Year 1 rent), amortized straight-line over the 38-month term (Jan 2027 = month 1); the unamortized share is the months remaining after March 2029 over 38. Round to cents.

items.label: Total cost to leave 31 Mar 2029 under the dropped s.20
items.source: Sum of the two items: rent during the Jan-Mar 2029 notice period, plus unamortized free rent at a 31 Mar 2029 termination.

items.label: Value of the dropped s.20 if Eden decides to leave on 1 Jan 2029
items.source: Remaining rent from 1 Jan 2029 to lease end, less total cost to leave 31 Mar 2029 under the dropped s.20.

items.label: Unamortized free rent at end of term month 24 (Fin estimate check)
items.source: LL-Redline-1-Suite170.docx (landlord redline 16 Nov 2026; copy at projects/legal/boise-lease-suite170/03-LL-Redline-1-Suite170.docx) struck s.20 says the reimbursement is 'anticipated not to exceed approximately' a stated sum at month 24. Compute: two abated months' value x (months remaining after term month 24) / 38, Jan 2027 = month 1. Round to cents.

items.label: Fallback B: rent avoided by a termination effective 30 Jun 2029
items.source: LL-Redline-1-Suite170.docx (landlord redline 16 Nov 2026; copy at projects/legal/boise-lease-suite170/03-LL-Redline-1-Suite170.docx) s.3. Sum of monthly rent from July 2029 through the last month of the term (Feb 2030).

items.label: Fallback B: termination fee (2 months Year 3 rent plus unamortized free rent at 30 Jun 2029)
items.source: 02-ll-redline-1-review.md fallback B: fee = two months of Year 3 rent plus the two abated months' value x (months remaining after June 2029)/38 (Jan 2027 = month 1), cents rounded. Excludes leasing commissions (amount unknown).

items.label: Fallback B: net saving to Eden
items.source: Fallback B rent avoided less fallback B termination fee.

items.label: Months of term remaining after term month 30
items.source: LL-Redline-1-Suite170.docx (landlord redline 16 Nov 2026; copy at projects/legal/boise-lease-suite170/03-LL-Redline-1-Suite170.docx) s.1. 38-month term from 1 Jan 2027 possession; count of months after June 2029 through end of term.
